approvalContract: Only explicitly named PNG bytes inside each SHA-256-bound ZIP are approved. Manifest source and candidate hashes are verified before application. Every named candidate was compared individually on white, dark and checker backgrounds. Explicit corrected candidates also bind final decoded RGBA.

notApproved.reason: Enlarged result retains opaque white/checker patches below signs inside the open support frame; additional precise alpha work needed. Original remains unchanged.
Original left bow is already clipped by the image frame. Background extraction cannot reconstruct missing geometry; preserve original and record HOLD.
Enlarged result leaves filled background between upper railings and removes parts of fine rail structures. Reject candidate; preserve source.
White mast and upper-rail gaps merge into opaque background patches and fine antenna fidelity is not sufficient. Reject candidate rather than force deployment.

Detached fragment can be removed but enlarged original already has transparent holes at the white cabin/window seam, with lost RGB in those pixels. Alpha-only candidate does not restore that damage; preserve original and do not claim full repair.
